title: Pokemon TCG Glaceon Prismatic Evolutions 025/131 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Glaceon Pokémon card from the Prismatic Evolutions set, featuring a Holofoil Rare finish. This card is numbered 025/131 and belongs to the Pokémon card game. It is a holo version of Glaceon, a character from the Pokémon series. The card is in mint condition.
